title: Europa Universalis V (Steam)
note: Current benchmark for historical grand strategy depth — EU5's pop simulation and economic systems show the direction the genre is evolving; informed Portolan's economic-first design philosophy

title: Terra Invicta 1.0 (PC Gamer)
note: Deep niche grand strategy with asymmetric factions reaching 88% positive — validated the market appetite for simulation depth and non-standard win conditions

title: Strategy Games Are Broken (Game Developer)
note: Jon Shafer diagnosis of midgame drag and puzzle-like design — directly shaped Portolan's mid-game shock system and commitment to decision clarity over system breadth

title: Indian Ocean Trade before the European Conquest (World History Encyclopedia)
note: Primary historical source for monsoon patterns commodity flows and trade network structure that ground Portolan's setting and mechanics

title: Kilwa Kisiwani and Indian Ocean Trade (Charter Cities Institute)
note: Documents the Kilwa Sultanate as the East African entrepôt controlling the gold and ivory trade — historical basis for Kilwa as a fully-playable faction with unique geographic leverage
